## tsa16-p01
Now is of absent one initiation — twofold it is: dead and living. (16.1) Therein, done-teacher-service itself is dead, or exiled, or sorcery-etc.-struck, or child-struck, or death-moment-risen-such-taste, or other-mouth-descent — thus is to be initiated — so the command. (16.2) Here, in dead-initiation, lodging-and-the-rest is not useful. (16.3) For maṇḍala, for mantra-particular-presence, where much rite, best material, flowers, place, seat, circle, triśūla-lotus-shape, meditation-particular, mantra, self-blazing, of meditation-intent yogin, of that-one-devotion-immersion-possessing knower — relation — these presence-causes as latter-best stated. (16.4) In collected-ness, what tale? — so the Lord stated. (16.5) Then god worshipped, his kuśa-made form placed before, through teacher-seat-etc. knowledge-teaching course, it one should see. It, from root-base rising, spread-far-flung-endless-channel-course-staff, by vigor having crossed, nose-sky-pervading, scattering, to pervade wishes. (16.6) As far as smoke-lovely-thick-net-covered course-wheel having covered, desired-soul-bringing — thus great net-named practice. (16.7) Through it, to-be-covered going to subdued facedness first; after, if whole, brought; then too from course-middle as wished. (16.8) In pulling, in lifting, in dead-folk object, in to-be-drawn, then in living, is yoga — by Śrī-Śambhunātha-āgama-understood, net-named, by me stated. (16.9) Outside too, thus how not? In pulling-and-the-rest, without practice — if so: through passion-hate-and-rest-yoga-force that functioning, from lordship-immersion-yoga (no). (16.10) Then from destiny-controlled-ness, practice-and-the-rest-need certainly. (16.11) Here, through grace-natured-Lord-nature-immersion, such-becoming. (16.12) For the Lord itself, through teacher-body-abiding door, the to-be-graced graces. (16.13) It is inconceivable-greatness — so much stated. (16.14) Thus net-practice-drawn soul into kuśa, jāti-fruit-or-rest body entered becomes; nor does it throb — from mind-breath-and-rest-material-lack. But through contemplation-power it throbs too even in such. In it, as before, sprinkling-and-rest-sacrament, full-offering-joining-end. (16.15) Here more: by full-offering, of it kuśa-and-rest-form's dissolution in supreme-glow to be made. (16.16) Thus lifted, it is dismissed by full-offering itself, if standing in hell/ghost/beast. (16.17) Human, then, at once gains knowledge, yoga, initiation, discernment. (16.18) From fit body — so dead-lifting. (16.19) Living too, absent, with descent arisen, this same course — except kuśa-body-soul-drawing. (16.20) Meditation-raised alone, of it, sacrament. (16.21) Initiation gives both fruits. (16.22) Since latency-strong, of many, upper-rule sacrament is strong; others for its sacrament. (16.23) Even of absent-initiated, likewise knowledge-rise. (16.24)

## tsa16-p01 — initiating the absent
Initiation at a distance comes in two kinds: for the dead and for the living. The dead who qualify: those who served a teacher, or were exiled, killed by sorcery or childhood, who tasted descent at the death-moment, or got it through another's mouth — the Lord's command. For the dead, no lodging-rites. The circle's presence-causes are graded: a lot of rite, best gear, flowers, place, seat, circle, trident-lotus shape, a meditation-particular, mantra, self-blazing, and the bond of a devoted knower — latter-best. Gathered, what's the story? — says the Lord. Worship the god, set his kuśa-made form before you, and see it through the course of knowledge the teacher seeded. It rises from the root-seat, crosses endless channels by vigor, pervades nose-and-sky, scattering to fill. The great net-practice: smoke-lovely, thick-net-covered, a course-wheel that covers the desired soul — first subduing and facing, then, if whole, drawing it, then from mid-course as you wish. Dead or living, pulling or lifting — Śambhunātha's net-yoga, mine. Outside too — how not? In pulling without practice, passion-hate-yoga would seem to give lordship-immersion — but destiny rules; practice is needed. Here, through grace-Lord-immersion, it works; the Lord graces through the teacher's body-door — inconceivable greatness, much said. Net-drawn, the soul enters a kuśa body or jāti-fruit body, unthrobbing (mind-breath-material lacking) — yet it throbs by contemplation-power; sacraments as before, ending in joining full-offering. There, by full-offering, its kuśa-form dissolves in supreme glow — lifted. If in hell, ghost, or beast, freed. A human at once gains knowledge, yoga, initiation, discernment — that is dead-lifting. The living, absent, with descent arisen: same course, minus soul-drawing. Meditation-raised alone, of it, sacrament; initiation gives both fruits. Latency-strong, many need upper-rule sacraments; others, its sacrament. Even absent-initiated, knowledge rises.

The passage moves in seven steps. (1) Eligibility of dead (teacher-served, exiled, sorcery/child-struck, death-moment-tasted, other-mouth-descent). (2) Presence-causes graded (much rite → best materials → flowers → place → seat → circle → shape → meditation → mantra → self-blazing + devoted-knower). (3) Worship god, set kuśa-form before, see it via teacher-seeded knowledge-course (root-rising, channel-crossing, nose-sky-pervading, scattering). (4) Net-practice (smoke-lovely, thick-net-covered course-wheel: subduing/facing first, then drawing whole, then mid-course as wished). (5) Dead/living: Śambhunātha-taught net-yoga (outside too; without practice, passion-hate-yoga would give lordship-immersion — but destiny rules; practice needed; here grace-Lord-immersion works through teacher-body door). (6) Net-drawn soul enters kuśa/jāti-fruit body (unthrobbing, throbs by contemplation; sacraments as before ending in joining full-offering); by full-offering kuśa-form dissolves in supreme glow (lifted; hell/ghost/beast freed; human gains knowledge/yoga/initiation/discernment). (7) Living absent: same minus soul-drawing; meditation-raised sacrament; initiation gives both fruits; latency-strong → upper-rule sacraments; even absent-initiated, knowledge rises.
